d:
Tilak marg thane ke samne
Jo bijli ka ek bara baks hai
Uske pichhe nali par bani jhuggi ka vakya hai yah
Chalis ke karib umr ka bap
Sukhi sanvli lanbi-si kaya pareshan betartib barhi darhi
Apne hath men ek patli hari dali lie khara huaa
Naraj ho raha tha apni
Panch sal aur sava sal ki betiyon par
